triples.tail_surface: inspection of gear train without disassembling contra-rotating propeller unit
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 不拆解对转螺旋桨装置检查齿轮系
triples.evidence_text: Adequate access covers are to be provided to permit inspection of gear train without disassembling contra-rotating propeller unit.

triples.tail_surface: provide all bearings, gear meshes and other parts requiring lubrication oil with an adequate amount of oil for both lubrication and cooling purposes
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 为所有轴承、齿轮啮合及其他需油部件提供足量润滑油用于润滑和冷却
triples.evidence_text: The lubrication system is to be designed to provide all bearings, gear meshes and other parts requiring lubrication oil with an adequate amount of oil for both lubrication and cooling purposes. This is to be maintained under all operating conditions.
An arrangement for readily obtaining accurate oil samples is to be provided. The sampling point is to be taken from the lowest point in the oil lubricating system, as far as practicable.

triples.tail_surface: effective removal of contaminants from the oil lubricating system
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 有效去除油润滑系统中的污染物
triples.evidence_text: Also, the arrangements are to be such as to permit the effective removal of contaminants from the oil lubricating system.
